hero.subtitle: Rail yard & hub teaching toolkit
hero.description: Modeling, calculation and 2D/3D visualization for hump profile design and station capacity analysis

features.title: Core Features
features.subtitle: Hump profile design and station capacity analysis for railway teaching and scheme evaluation

hump.title: Hump Profile Design
hump.description: Design longitudinal profiles and analyze wagon release operations using yard layouts, vehicle parameters and calculation conditions.

profile.title: Yard Layout and Gradient Design
profile.description: Define the hump layout and release tracks, set segment lengths and gradients, and construct longitudinal profiles.

energy.title: Vehicle Parameters and Energy Height
energy.description: Configure vehicles, calculation conditions and retarder states. Calculate resistance and kinetic energy heights to analyze energy changes during release.

headway.title: Release Curves and Headway Checks
headway.description: Calculate speed and elapsed time along the release track, and check headways between successive cuts to assess profile designs.

simulation.title: 2D and 3D Release Simulation
simulation.description: Visualize calculated wagon movements in 2D and 3D to examine track positions and operational timing.

capacity.title: Station Capacity Analysis
capacity.description: Develop station operation plans, estimate capacity and analyze bottlenecks using track topology, operation timing and section occupancy.
capacity.preview: In phased development · Phase 1 Preview expected around the end of 2026.

layout.title: Station Topology and Route Modeling
layout.description: Draw station layouts, define tracks, turnouts, signals and track circuit sections, and establish routes and resource occupancy relationships.

planning.title: Operation Modeling and Planning
planning.description: Represent operations through activities, events and precedence constraints. Create plans manually, with automatic generation planned through solver integration.

analysis.title: Section Occupancy and Capacity
analysis.description: Calculate occupancy durations and utilization from operation plans, identify bottleneck sections, and summarize capacity estimates by route category.

playback.title: 2D and 3D Operation Playback
playback.description: Display train arrivals, dwell periods and departures alongside route occupancy to examine the temporal and spatial relationships in a plan.

password.title: Password Hashing
password.p2: Argon2 password hashes stored on the server

professional.title: Professional Teaching Tool
professional.p: SwitchYard is a comprehensive toolkit designed for teaching rail yards and hubs. It uses modern frontend-backend separation to provide an intuitive and efficient platform for teachers and students.

modules.title: Two Core Modules
modules.p: The toolkit is organized around hump profile design and station capacity analysis. The hump module covers profile design, energy heights and wagon release analysis. The capacity module is being developed in phases for station modeling, operation planning, section occupancy and capacity analysis.

open.title: Open Source & Collaboration
open.p: The project is open source — contributions from developers and rail professionals are welcome.

maintainer.title: Maintainers
maintainer.organization: School of Transportation, Beijing Jiaotong University

tooltip.pure:
Basic Resistance EH
h0 = (r0,sl · Lsl + r0,yd · Lyd) / 1000
r0 = 2.439 + (0.00008·Q − 0.01743)·t − 0.015·Q + 0.00017·t² + 0.1·v + n·1.65·σ + (1−k)·0.39
σ = 0.602 − (0.0012 + 0.00002·Q)·t − 0.003·Q + 0.00002·t²
Q = {Q} t; t = {temp} °C; n = {n} (wagon type); vsl = {vSlope} m/s (k=0); vyd = {vYard} m/s (k=1); r0,sl = {r0Slope} N/kN; r0,yd = {r0Yard} N/kN; Lsl = {lSlope} m; Lyd = {lYard} m
tooltip.air:
Wind Resistance EH
hw = (rw,sl · Lsl + rw,yd · Lyd) / 1000
rw = (ρ · f · cx1/cx0) / (2 · Q · cos²α) · (v + ξ · vw · cosβ)²
α = arctan((vw · sinβ) / (v + ξ · vw · cosβ))
Q = {Q} t; ρ = {rho} kg·s²/m⁴; f = {f} m²; vw = {vWind} m/s; ξ = {xi}; β = 0°; α = 0°; cx1/cx0 = 1; vsl = {vSlope} m/s; vyd = {vYard} m/s; rw,sl = {rwSlope} N/kN; rw,yd = {rwYard} N/kN; Lsl = {lSlope} m; Lyd = {lYard} m
tooltip.switch:
Switch Resistance EH
hs = Es / 1000
Es = 24·Nrev + 12·(Nfwd + Ndia) + 48·Nslip
Nrev = {nReverse}; Nfwd = {nForward}; Ndia = {nDiamond}; Nslip = {nSlip}; Es = {Es} N·m/kN
tooltip.curve:
Curve Resistance EH
hc = Ec / 1000
Ec = 8 · θtotal = 8 · (θcurve + θswitch)
θcurve = {pureCurve} ° (curve corner); θswitch = {switchCurve} ° (switch corner); θtotal = {totalCurve} °; Ec = {Ec} N·m/kN
